function.name: game_functions_solve_jigsaw
function.description: Generate solution for a given jigsaw puzzle image. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

puzzle_image.description: The image file of the jigsaw puzzle.

pieces_count.description: Number of pieces in the jigsaw puzzle.

solve_method.description: Method to be used to solve the puzzle. Default is brute_force.

message.content: I’m not sure exactly what you’d like me to do—do you want me to generate a new jigsaw puzzle image for you, or would you like me to solve an existing puzzle? If you have an image you’d like turned into a puzzle, let me know how many pieces you’d prefer, and I can help you set it up. If you already have a puzzle image and just want it solved, just share the image file and the number of pieces, and I’ll use the solver tool for you.
